title: Windows CI red: raise per-suite timeout to 600s for the spawn-slow Windows job
action: Run 30270865821 (Node-20, windows-latest): test_worktree_store.mjs killed by run_verify's 300s per-suite timeout (exit 124, TIMEOUT at exactly 300000ms) while every executed check inside it passed; test_reviews finished at 265s, just under the wire; the Node-22 job on the same commit was green. Windows process spawn makes the git-heavy suites 2-4x slower — this is environment speed, not logic. Fix: add BEE_VERIFY_SUITE_TIMEOUT_MS: "600000" to the portable-suites step env in .github/workflows/windows.yml (run_verify already honors the variable; job-level timeout-minutes: 30 still bounds the run). One env line + a one-line comment naming the evidence run.

truths: no other workflow or default timeout changed

Do NOT change the 300s default in run_verify.mjs
